prompt: Create ORIGINAL production concept artwork for HOLLOWPACT, a gritty realistic monster-binding hunter tactical game. Menacing, austere, believable old-world craftsmanship, no cute folklore, no cheerful colours, no comic or stylized outlines, no characters, no monsters, no text, no logos, no HUD or card elements, no visible franchise references. Designed to be an actual game combat background behind full silhouettes, carefully restrained detail where targets stand; commercial concept art aspiration, not screenshot or quality certification.
